title: Predict the next token
summary: A language model gives scores to possible next tokens using the current context. A selection rule then chooses one of them.
introduction: A language model gives scores to possible next tokens using the current context. A selection rule then chooses one of them. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A language model gives scores to possible next tokens using the current context. A selection rule then chooses one of them.
The output is flies because its score is largest. These supplied values only demonstrate selection; no trained model calculated them.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Raise the score for falls above 0.6.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: The most likely next word is not necessarily a fact about the world.
For more detail later, use this [Large Language Models further reading](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1).
